situations.title: 뇌사 개념·법적 절차 이해
situations.tagline: The doctor used the words 'brain death' — I don't understand what that really means.
situations.brief: 뇌사의 개념과 법적 판정 절차를 가족이 이해하도록 존중하며 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Brain death means the brain has permanently stopped working.
There is a careful, legal process the doctors follow to confirm it.
I'll stay with you and answer your questions as we go.
goals: 뇌사의 의미를 존중하며 이해하기 쉽게 설명한다
법적 판정 절차의 개요를 가족에게 안내한다

situations.title: 뇌간반사 검사 준비 보조
situations.tagline: Let's get set up for the brainstem reflex exam — can you help me position him?
situations.brief: 뇌간반사 검사를 위해 환자를 준비하고 의료진의 검사를 존중하며 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll have the exam supplies and documentation ready.
Let me position him and confirm the sedation has cleared.
Tell me which reflex you want to test next.

situations.title: 무호흡 검사 준비
situations.tagline: We're prepping for the apnea test — can you preoxygenate and draw a baseline gas?
situations.brief: 무호흡 검사를 위해 사전 산소화와 기저 혈액가스 세팅을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll preoxygenate him to a hundred percent first.
Baseline blood gas is drawn and sent.
Everything is set for the apnea test to begin.
goals: 무호흡 검사 전 산소화와 검체를 준비한다

situations.title: 가족에게 상태 설명 지원
situations.tagline: So there's really no chance — his brain isn't working at all?
situations.brief: 의료진 설명을 보완하며 가족이 상태를 이해하도록 존중하며 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: That's right, and I'm so sorry to confirm this for you.
Please take your time, and ask me anything you need to.
I'll make sure the doctor explains anything that's still unclear.

situations.title: 장기기증 기관 연계 인지
situations.tagline: I've notified the OPO, and they'll be reaching out about donation.
situations.brief: 장기구득기관 통보 절차를 이해하고 코디네이터와의 연계를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: The OPO has been notified per protocol.
They'll speak with the family separately about donation.
Let's keep documentation ready for the coordinator.

situations.title: 기증 전 신체 유지 기초
situations.tagline: Let's keep him stable — how are his pressures and temperature holding?
situations.brief: 기증 가능성을 위해 활력징후와 항상성을 안정적으로 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: His pressure is holding with the current support.
I'm keeping him warm and watching the temperature.
Let me know if you want to adjust the fluids.

situations.title: 무호흡 검사 중 안전 감시
situations.tagline: Watch his sats closely during the apnea test — call it if he desaturates.
situations.brief: 무호흡 검사 중 산소포화도 저하에 대비하며 안전하게 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm watching his saturation and vitals continuously.
If he desaturates, we abort and reconnect the vent.
Rescue equipment is at the bedside and ready.
goals: 검사 중 산소포화도와 활력을 지속 감시한다

situations.title: 뇌사 후 혈역학 유지
situations.tagline: His pressure keeps dropping — do you want to start pressors and give fluids?
situations.brief: 뇌사 후 저혈압에 대응해 승압제와 수액으로 혈역학을 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's start the pressor and titrate to the target pressure.
I'll give a fluid bolus and reassess.
We're keeping his perfusion stable for donation.

situations.title: 요붕증 관리
situations.tagline: His urine output is huge and his sodium's climbing — this looks like DI.
situations.brief: 요붕증에 대응해 데스모프레신과 수액으로 전해질과 배뇨를 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's give desmopressin and match the fluid losses.
I'll recheck his sodium and urine output closely.
We need to keep his volume and electrolytes stable.

situations.title: 체온·전해질 유지
situations.tagline: He's getting cold and his potassium is off — let's correct these together.
situations.brief: 기증을 위해 체온과 전해질 항상성을 안정적으로 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll start the warming blanket to bring his temperature up.
Let's replace the potassium and recheck.
We're keeping his internal balance steady.

situations.title: 기증 위한 폐 보호 환기
situations.tagline: For the lungs to be usable, we need to keep him on protective vent settings.
situations.brief: 기증 폐 보호를 위해 폐 보호 환기 전략을 유지하고 호흡팀과 협력하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's keep tidal volumes low and PEEP optimized.
I'll suction gently and reposition to protect the lungs.
We're preserving lung function for possible donation.
goals: 기증 폐 기능을 보존하며 호흡팀과 협력한다

situations.title: 가족 사별 지원·소통
situations.tagline: I don't know how to say goodbye to my son.
situations.brief: 사별을 앞둔 가족의 애도를 존중하며 정서적으로 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: Take all the time you need to be with him.
There's no wrong way to say goodbye.
I'm here with you, and we can call anyone you'd like.

situations.title: 동의·문화적 고려
situations.tagline: In our family, we need to speak with our elders before deciding on donation.
situations.brief: 기증 결정에서 가족의 문화적 가치와 절차를 존중하며 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Of course — your family's wishes and beliefs come first.
Take the time you need to speak with your elders.
I can arrange for the coordinator to speak with all of you together.
goals: 가족의 문화적 가치를 존중하며 결정을 지원한다

situations.title: 기증 코디네이터 협업
situations.tagline: I'm the organ procurement coordinator — can we line up the labs and the timeline together?
situations.brief: 기증 코디네이터와 검사와 일정을 조율하며 원활히 협업하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's map out which labs still need to be drawn.
I'll coordinate the bedside timing with your schedule.
Tell me what you need from us to keep this moving.
goals: 기증 일정에 맞춰 협업 절차를 정리한다

situations.title: 순환정지후 기증 이해
situations.tagline: This would be a DCD pathway — let me walk you through how it differs.
situations.brief: 순환정지후 기증의 절차 차이를 이해하고 팀과 준비를 맞추세요.
keyPhrases: In DCD, donation follows withdrawal and circulatory death.
The timing and roles are different from brain death donation.
Let's confirm each step so we're all aligned.

situations.title: 무호흡 검사 중 급변 위기
situations.tagline: His pressure just crashed during the apnea test — abort and put him back on the vent.
situations.brief: 무호흡 검사 중 급변에 즉시 검사를 중단하고 소생 조치를 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Aborting now — reconnecting him to the ventilator.
Start pressors and give a fluid bolus.
Let's stabilize him before anything else.

situations.title: 뇌사 후 순환 붕괴 위기
situations.tagline: His pressure is bottoming out — we're losing him unless we escalate now.
situations.brief: 뇌사 후 순환 붕괴 위기에서 기증 유지를 위해 신속히 에스컬레이션하세요.
keyPhrases: Max the pressors and give volume now.
I'm calling the physician and the coordinator.
Let's do everything to hold his perfusion.
goals: 순환 붕괴에 승압과 수액으로 신속히 대응한다

situations.title: 심한 요붕증 급변 관리
situations.tagline: His urine is pouring out and his sodium's skyrocketing — this DI is out of control.
situations.brief: 심한 요붕증 급변에서 다뇨와 전해질 붕괴를 즉시 교정하세요.
keyPhrases: Give desmopressin now and start matching the losses.
Recheck the sodium immediately and correct carefully.
We need to stop this before his electrolytes crash.

situations.title: 가족 갈등·기증 거부 상황
situations.tagline: You are not taking anything from him — how dare you even ask us right now.
situations.brief: 기증을 거부하는 가족의 분노를 존중하며 윤리적으로 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: I hear you, and your family's wishes will be respected.
There is no pressure — this is entirely your decision.
I'm here to support you, whatever you choose.

situations.title: 판정 시점·연명 갈등
situations.tagline: If his heart is still beating, how can you tell me he's already gone?
situations.brief: 뇌사 판정 시점과 연명에 대한 가족의 혼란을 다학제적으로 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: The machine is keeping his heart going, but his brain has stopped.
I know this is very hard to reconcile.
Let's bring the whole team together to talk it through with you.
goals: 뇌사 판정과 심박 유지의 차이를 존중하며 설명한다

situations.title: 기증 장기 기능 유지 위기
situations.tagline: We're losing the kidneys — we need to optimize him fast or we lose the offer.
situations.brief: 기증 장기 기능 저하 위기에서 최적화와 신속한 에스컬레이션을 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's optimize his perfusion and urine output now.
I'll adjust the pressors and fluids per protocol.
Call the coordinator so we can escalate quickly.
goals: 장기 기능 저하에 신속히 최적화 조치를 취한다
